action.description: Action to perform: 'get' reads the effective proxy settings, 'set' writes them, 'list_services' lists the routable service selectors. 'apply_env' and 'clear_env' are always refused: PRX never modifies the process environment. Defaults to 'get'.

all_proxy.description: Fallback proxy URL for all protocols

no_proxy.description: Comma-separated string or array of NO_PROXY entries

scope.description: Proxy scope. Canonical values: prx, services. 'environment' (alias 'env') is refused by 'set': it is inactive because PRX never modifies the process environment.

services.description: Comma-separated string or array of service selectors; required when 'set' targets scope=services
